title: Ninja v3 Is Live — Where We Are and What Comes Next
summary: AL Object ID Ninja v3 backend and VS Code extension are now in production with over 1,300 automated tests. The post covers the transition to commercial billing starting January 1st, new pricing models (flat per-user/app and pay-per-use), and maintenance expectations for self-hosted deployments during the feature expansion phase.
key_points: Ninja v3 backend is live on new endpoints with latest Node runtime and comprehensive test coverage
Billing is free until January 1st; pricing has shifted from elastic to flat rates per user/app with optional pre-packaged tiers and pay-per-use model
Early Bird subscribers keep their original pricing indefinitely as long as they stay within specified limits, with flexibility to switch tiers anytime
Self-hosted backend deployments should expect more frequent updates in coming months as new features are added
features: AL Object ID Ninja backend v3
